title: Understanding test limits
summary: Separate a negative result from certainty.

cards.title: What a negative result can leave unknown
body: A test may not find every relevant gene change. Its scope matters.
Compare two assumptions for a teaching example. A result below complete detection leaves some carrier chance in this model.
Complete detection is a mathematical assumption here, not a claim about any laboratory.

cards.title: Uncertain is not a prediction
body: A variant of uncertain significance is a gene change whose health meaning is not yet clear.
It does not establish that someone has a condition.
Not tested means unknown, not absent. This card gives no numerical estimate.
